title: Andrew John Volstead House, 163 Ninth Avenue, Granite Falls, Yellow Medicine County, MN
notes: Significance: Home of the man who "personified prohibition."  Volstead served in the House of Representatives (1903-23) where as chairman of the House Judiciary Committee he drafted the 1919 National Prohibition Enforcement Act, better known as the "Volstead Act."
